scope: Correct CP154's equality-oriented shortlist objective without repeating its broad PDS oversweep: extend the Kinetic RC2 lower boundary, rescore focused Energy/AMM architecture candidates in the CP153 direct-fire-versus-missile environment, enforce hard technology progression, and deep-confirm a stratified Pareto/viability set rather than a single equalized triad.

balancePhilosophy.primary: Distinct strategically viable choices; numerical equality is not a goal. TL-specific swings and temporary superiority are acceptable. Persistent dominance, persistent obsolescence, or hard exclusion are failures.
balancePhilosophy.forbiddenSelectorObjective: No global distance-to-50-percent objective and no inter-family win-rate-variance minimization may select PDS ladders or triads.
balancePhilosophy.missileAnchor: The native-accepted CP153 main-weapon equilibrium remains fixed. GP/Swarmer against a non-PDS K/E defender is intentionally dangerous; PDS buys counterplay rather than erasing missile identity.
balancePhilosophy.comparison: K-PDS, E-PDS, and AMM may lead different TLs, missile matchups, and resource environments. Final evidence is Pareto/viability-oriented, not equalization-oriented.

historicalPdsEvidence.latestFullCombatReference: Combat Model Lab v17-v19 as registered by CP142
knownSensitivities: Reaction-capacity changes are discrete architecture breakpoints, not smooth stats.
Chance x reaction-capacity is a dominant PDS interaction.
Ammunition is primarily an exhaustion/endurance constraint once a practical threshold is reached.
The earlier research branch carried Kinetic RC2 from TL6 and a late AMM range-1 third opportunity; these are priors, not automatic restorations.

candidateDesign.attackers: GP M2, GP M3, and Swarmer SW2 where unlocked

kinetic.ammoPolicy: Fixed endurance constant for this pass; not an optimization axis.

energy.note: CP154 already mapped Strain 1-4 broadly; CP155 deep-confirms the doctrine-consistent 1-2 region and safe maturation.

amm.ammoPolicy: Fixed deliberately exhaustible magazine; not an optimization axis.

common: Capability unlocks do not disappear at later TLs.
kinetic: RC is limited to 1 or 2 and remains same-hex only.
If RC2 unlocks, it remains available thereafter.
Within an unchanged RC state, full readiness TP may hold or improve but may not worsen; an RC1-to-RC2 capability jump may require a higher full-readiness TP.
Ammunition is fixed at 75 throughout the ladder for this pass.
energy: RC is limited to 1 or 2 and remains same-hex only.
RC2 requires more TP than RC1.
Overcharged RC2 may mature into safe RC2; safe RC2 may not regress into strain-requiring RC2.
Overcharged Strain Limit may hold or improve from 1 to 2 but may not regress.
Within the same capability state, readiness TP may hold or improve but may not worsen.
amm: RC3 always and only means one range-1 opportunity plus the two terminal opportunities.
Once RC3/range-1 unlocks it remains available.
Within an unchanged RC state, full readiness TP may hold or improve but may not worsen; an RC capability jump may require a higher full-readiness TP.
Ammunition is fixed at 25 throughout the ladder for this pass.

selectionDesign.method: Build technology-valid whole-ladder paths from actually tested candidates; stratify by architecture and empirical protection-uplift strength; use Pareto/frontier and diversity sampling rather than a single scalar balance target.

requiredArchitectureCoverage.kinetic: Include RC1 controls and multiple natural-RC2 unlock trajectories spanning the late ladder.
requiredArchitectureCoverage.energy: Include RC1 controls, Strain-1 and Strain-2 overcharged-RC2 trajectories, and trajectories that mature from overcharged to safe RC2.
requiredArchitectureCoverage.amm: Include RC1/RC2 controls and multiple RC3/range-1 unlock trajectories.

selectionDesign.strengthSampling: Low/mid/high protection-uplift frontier points are all eligible so deep confirmation observes trade space instead of preselecting a desired win rate.

deepConfirmation.primaryContexts: Full K1/E7 defender x GP M2/GP M3/SW2 attacker x six strata x five resources crossing.
deepConfirmation.robustnessContexts: Missile-armed defenders are retained only as secondary diagnostics at R1_CENTRAL_NO_MAJOR; they do not drive ladder selection.
deepConfirmation.noPdsBaseline: A separate same-context no-PDS reference quantifies protection uplift and verifies preservation of the CP153 missile-threat anchor.
deepConfirmation.triadAnalysis: All 10 x 10 x 10 family combinations receive offline leadership/dominance/viability diagnostics. No equalization score is computed.

heldFixed: CP153 K1/E7/M2-or-M3/SW2 mains; current Hull/Shield/Armor/DEF/RES; current AUX, EW/Sensor, movement/cadence, PDS Space, and provisional Reactor/TP supply.
deferred: production C# and active Concept/numerical-matrix promotion
